//: Vercel builds the public pages here rather than being handed a folder.
export_site.py is standard-library only, so the build needs no install
step and no requirements — and the site is regenerated from source on
every push, which means it can never drift from the strategy it
describes. The how-it-works page reads its numbers straight out of
config.py, so a stale export would describe rules the tool is no longer
Only the public pages are built here. The tool itself cannot run on
Vercel: it holds a Zerodha WebSocket open, keeps ticket state in memory
between polls, and writes accounts and trade history to disk. Add
--app-url below once it is hosted, and every Log in button points at it
installCommand: echo 'no dependencies — export_site.py is stdlib only'

headers.value: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
